# Report - video9, L1 proxy, Three.js sampled-frame baseline (round 001)

Representation level: L1 (simple geometric proxies). This is the Three.js sampled-frame baseline, not a Blender protocol reproduction.

## Observed (from the 24 reference samples)
- Pillarboxed ~1.37:1 image inside the 1280x720 frame (black side bars, thin top/bottom bars).
- Shot A (samples 0-3, 0-3.13 s): concierge in purple tailcoat and grey trousers walks toward a retreating camera, writing in a small notebook; lobby boy (purple uniform, pillbox hat) follows behind on image-right. A man in a dark overcoat passes on image-left, a doorman on the right raises his hat, a doorman in a purple coat with flowers stands left; Gustave raises his right index finger around 2 s.
- Shot B (samples 4-9, 4.17-9.38 s): tight side-tracking close-up; Gustave in left foreground facing image-right writing, lobby boy beside/behind him at right; background lobby (lit arches, tables, palm, marble pillar) slides leftward.
- Shot C (sample 10, 10.43 s): reverse angle down the red-carpet runner; a second bellboy walks toward the camera; chef in white and a lady in black in the background, arches on image-left, palm/pillar on image-right.
- Shot D (samples 11-16, 11.47-16.64 s): dolly-back on Gustave and the lobby boy; second bellboy joins on the left and falls back, lady with a black dog enters right, chef with a box enters left and presents it to Gustave who turns to look.
- Shot E (samples 17-23, 17.68-23.94 s): side-tracking close-up again in a salon (mural, cream double doors, sofa, round table); lobby boy alternates looking down at the notebook and at Gustave; Gustave turns his head toward him around 20-22 s.

## Inferred / modelling choices
- Cut times are not observed; placed between samples at 3.65, 9.9, 10.95 and 17.2 s.
- Camera is solved each frame from Gustave's head position and keyframed screen targets (measured from the samples), so the camera dollies/tracks with the walkers while the 3D set stays static (true parallax). Other walkers are placed by keyframed screen x + depth relative to that camera, interpolated with smooth Hermite curves.
- People: articulated proxies (hips, thighs, knees, torso, neck/head, shoulders, elbows, hands) with analytic walk cycles; Gustave holds a notebook (left hand) and pen (right hand) with a writing oscillation and a pointing gesture; lobby boy hands clasped; lady carries a black dog ellipsoid; chef carries a tan box and holds it out near the end of shot D; doorman's hat swaps from head to raised hand.
- Environment: red floor with runner, pink walls with bulb-lit arches, square marble pillars with potted palms, chandeliers of emissive spheres, tables with seated guests; a separate salon set for shot E.
- Text on hats/box and facial features omitted as appropriate for L1.

## Feedback
None received yet (initial round). Nothing has been rendered or verified by me.
